g.text: Proceed with BMD as target. Reproduce known finding using TFM feature importance.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Feature group importance (fitness #1, bone #10) becomes candidate mechanism. Build DAG from top features.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Proceed cautiously. Investigate which body-comp variables drive C signal before Aim 2.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Feature importance may conflate biology with noise. Do not build DAG until C source identified.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Do NOT proceed with BMD as-is. Options: arm-residualized target, within-arm modeling, or non-arm-graded target.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Feature importance is arm-detection, not biology. DAG would encode treatment assignment, not bone physiology.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: BMD not viable for Aim 2. Signal is arm-confounded and noise-contaminated. Return to Aim 1 boundary map.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: HMTA premature. Cannot generate biological hypotheses from arm-detection + noise-ranking.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Decision Matrix — Stated BEFORE Running, Fixed Thresholds

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: A survives: p_stratified < 0.05 AND p_residualized < 0.05. B survives: either fails. C alive: |rho| > 0.4 AND p < 0.10 in CONTROL (n=11) or EXERCISE (n=19) after Bonferroni. FLY (n=8) excluded from C criterion. Negative C check = undetectable, not absent.
